record.question: Osmotic pressure exerted by which of the following plays an important role in the exchange of various substances between blood and the cells?
record.explanation: Answer B: Plasma proteins. Plasma proteins, especially albumin, generate colloid oncotic pressure that influences fluid movement across capillaries. Reference: https://openstax.org/books/anatomy-and-physiology-2e/pages/20-3-capillary-exchange; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK459198/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
